sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Start the viewer on the page
sections.what: Finds the root element on the page and draws the app into it, with the development checks switched on.
sections.why: This is the single starting point. The error message explains that the page needs the root element.
sections.watch_out: The root element id must match the one in index.html.

summary: The entry point that attaches the viewer to the page and starts it.
purpose: Starts the whole viewer by drawing the top-level app into the page.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the error message, which says the page has no root element.
how: Finds the root element on the page. If it is missing, throws an error. Otherwise draws the app inside it, wrapped in React strict mode, which runs extra development checks.
inputs: The index.html page, which must contain an element with the id root, and the styles file.
outputs: The rendered viewer in the browser.
risks: If the root element id changes in index.html, the viewer does not start and shows nothing.
debug: If the page is blank, check that index.html contains the root element and read the browser console for the error message.
